command: uv run python -m bench.run --profile full --reuse-throughput bench/results/full.json

dataset.name: RAGTruth
dataset.licence: MIT for the RAGTruth annotations and code (ParticleMedia/RAGTruth); the source passages come from MS MARCO, CNN/Daily Mail and recent news articles, and the Yelp Open Dataset, under their own terms

primary_rule: highest dev AUROC among the NLI judges

length_baseline.score: number of checkable claim units in the response
length_baseline.strata_for_task_length_matched_auroc: task type x number of claim units

agreement.decision_rule: score >= F1-optimal threshold chosen on the calibration split

ppi.intervals: score (the default); wald_* keys hold the Wald interval for comparison

ppi_low_rate.batch: all faithful test responses plus a random subset of the hallucinated ones

measured_in.note: copied from that run's results file; not re-measured in this run

llm_judge.reason: needs an OpenAI-compatible endpoint; the adapter and the position-swap check are covered by tests with a scripted provider only
